facts.fact: When the handbook's file cannot be fetched, the window's text says this line; any user who opened the handbooks reads it.
A failed load is not kept, so the next request fetches the file again.
Pressing a book's tab, the open one included, calls show again through wireKitTabs onSwitch, which loads the book again.

en.before: This handbook could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
en.after: This handbook could not be loaded. Click its tab to try again.

removed: "Try again in a moment" becomes how to try again, its tab (O7, facts 1 and 2); the wait "in a moment" no code needs.

points: Consistency of the action word: a tab is clicked, the Polish says "Kliknij", and the module's other texts in this batch say "Click" (DRPG.Popup.moreCloseAll). "Press" for a tab is unusual in English UI copy. Facts 1-2 kept: reopening the tab loads it again. (proposed: "This handbook could not be loaded. Click its tab to try again.") - executor: Taken.
Naturalne; „Kliknij jego zakładkę” zgodne z faktem 2, zaimek „jego” odnosi się do podręcznika.
